subject: Physix pilot: request to extend pilot window and sandbox credits for SSO integration
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@physix.ai>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Patel <daniel.patel@physix.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: short extension + sandbox tokens — SSO blocker

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. We're making steady progress but hit an unexpected SAML assertion error when we attempted to finish the SSO connection in our staging environment. Our identity team is diagnosing, but it looks like the vendor-provided SAML middleware we use needs a small patch and a follow-up config change on our side.

Because of that, our integration timeline has slipped: we won't be able to complete the end-to-end flows for the pilot by the original end date (next Friday). We're still committed to rolling this out — the platform looks great — but we need a little more runway to get engineering time on the fix and finish end-to-end QA.

Two asks:
- Can we extend the pilot window by two weeks (new end date Apr 26)?
- Can you provision an extra sandbox token bucket (approx. 75k tokens) so we can finish the smoke tests once SSO is fixed?

I've attached the saml_error.log and a short screencap showing the assertion mismatch. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this pilot is high priority for Physix (we're targeting a Q3 launch).

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations
Physix

Attachments: saml_error.log (text), sso-screencap.mp4 (video)

From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@physix.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: short extension + sandbox tokens — SSO blocker

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the logs, that's helpful.

We're sorry to hear about the SAML hiccup. Quick internal check: Ben, Marcus — can we approve a two‑week extension and top up Physix's sandbox bucket while we triage the SSO patch? If so I'll confirm terms and get an agreement signed.

Samira — we'll also offer a 90‑minute engineering office hour with one of our infra engineers to help reproduce and validate the fix; would tomorrow or Monday work for you?

I'll wait for Ben/Marcus to confirm the extension + token amount and then send a short addendum for signatures.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Lukas — go ahead and approve this. Proposed terms from sales:
- Extension: 14 calendar days (new pilot end: 2027-04-26)
- Sandbox token top-up: 75,000 tokens (one-time, non-recurring)
- Addendum: short one-page extension agreement (legal OK)
- Value-add: 90-minute office hours with our infra lead (no charge)

I've updated the HubSpot deal (link below) and flagged finance for the credit. Marcus — please mark the tokens as promo in billing so they don't count against usage.

I think this is the right move — keeps momentum and preserves the close.

Hi Samira / Daniel — good news: we can accommodate both asks. Summary and next steps below.

Summary (approved):
- Pilot extension: 14 calendar days. New pilot end date: 2027-04-26.
- Sandbox tokens: 75,000 promotional tokens provisioned to your staging account (one-time).
- Office hours: 90-minute working session with our infra engineer — suggested slots Tue 4/13 10:00–11:30 PDT or Mon 4/19 14:00–15:30 PDT. Tell us what works.
- Paperwork: attached short extension-agreement.pdf. Please sign and return; this simply documents the new end date and the token grant.

We appreciate you sharing the logs — our infra engineer will review before the office hours so we can make the session productive. If you can also send the SAML metadata blob from your IdP that would help troubleshooting.

If this all looks good I'll mark the HubSpot deal and notify billing.

Thanks, and looking forward to getting you across the finish line.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
